uniform-swing-baseline.definition: pre-election notional major-party district baseline plus common statewide poll movement

polling-only.definition: frozen statewide polling state with ballot masks and no local geography

polling-plus-fundamentals.definition: deterministic statewide polling plus notional baseline and prediction-safe local fundamentals

seat-level-model.definition: independent district IRV marginals with fixed pre-score uncertainty and broad preference fallback

complete-ensemble.definition: reference to the sealed certifying v2 prediction; never regenerated by comparator scoring
